text_block_list.text:
Finally, the curtain rises for the spring
Tenno
Sho—the showdown between
Нарита Брайан and
Райс Шоуэр, the Sable
Assassin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Райс Шоуэр seems frail at a glance, but
a strong
will lies hidden within. Despite
being called "the
Assassin" and treated
like a villain, she doesn't
run away from
a race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Feeling respect for her resilience, Narita
Brian
puts her entire body and soul into
their
competition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
